about_the_game: A local esoterica shop has recently come into possession of a shipment of artifacts recovered from under the sea. The shop itself has a reputation for strange occurrences, but if you are bold, you could secure one or more of these powerful items...for a doom is rising in Arkham.
detailed_description: A local esoterica shop has recently come into possession of a shipment of artifacts recovered from under the sea.
